chunks: ʿAʾishah narrated from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم that he said:
"The people with the greatest regret on the Day of Resurrection are those who see their wudu (ablution) on the skin of someone else."
ai.seo_question: Who will have the greatest regret on the Day of Resurrection according to this hadith about wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith warns of severe regret on the Day of Resurrection connected to wudu (ablution) and its outward traces appearing on another person rather than oneself. It emphasizes the moral and devotional significance of properly performing acts of ritual purity and not neglecting their spiritual benefit.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.96 - Aisha narrated from the Prophet (sw), that He said:
"The people with the most regret on the Day of Resurrection will be those who sees his wudu (ablution) on the skin of someone else”.
